question:
Choose the most appropriate antonym of the underlined word.

Much to our collective **__astonishment__**, Chris ended up joining the military.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"astonishment"** means a feeling of great surprise or wonder. (आश्चर्य)

 
 
• **Example: **To their** astonishment**, the magician pulled a rabbit out of his hat.
 
 
 
• **"Composure" **refers to a state of being calm and in control of oneself, especially in a difficult situation. (शांतचित्तता)
 
 
• **Example: **She maintained her **composure **even during the stressful interview.
 
 

Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'astonishment' **is **'composure'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Shock **(सदमा): A sudden and intense disturbance of the mind or emotions.

 
 
• **Example:** The news of his sudden demise was a great** shock** to everyone.
 
 
 
• **Awe **(भयमिश्रित श्रद्धा): A feeling of reverential respect mixed with fear or wonder.
 
 
• **Example: **They watched in **awe** as the fireworks lit up the night sky.
 
 
 
• **Wonder** (आश्चर्य): A feeling of amazement and admiration, caused by something beautiful, remarkable, or unfamiliar.
 
 
• **Example:** The child looked at the rainbow with **wonder** in his eyes.
 
 

39:Taf2,

The correct answer is: **Option 3.**
